list.name: Tanya B.
list.text: Had them install a Level 2 charger for our new EV. They were on time, pulled the permit, and finished in about three hours. Everything passed inspection on the first visit. Couldn't ask for more.

list.name: Marcus W.
list.text: Our panel was an old Federal Pacific that our insurance threatened to drop us over. They replaced the whole thing in a day, coordinated the permit inspection, and now our insurance is happy. Fair price for a big job.

list.name: Lena K.
list.text: Called at 11pm when I smelled burning near an outlet. Someone actually answered, talked me through shutting off the circuit, and had a tech here by 8am. Found a loose connection that could have been a fire. Worth every penny.
